name: stockpile
headline: Stockpile: AI B-Roll Finder for Video Editors
short_description: Stockpile automatically finds and organizes relevant b-roll from YouTube based on your video content. It transcribes clips, extracts key topics, scores footage for quality, and delivers organized results—ideal for video editors and content creators.
author: sasoder

sections.overview:
Stockpile is an AI tool that automates b-roll discovery for video editors and content creators. Upload a video clip to your input folder (local or Google Drive), and the tool transcribes your content, extracts key topics and visuals, then searches YouTube for matching footage. It evaluates each video for b-roll quality and visual relevance, organizing results into labeled folders with relevance scores. The tool integrates with Google Drive for cloud workflows, includes email notifications, and uses Google's Gemini API for intelligent topic extraction and video evaluation. Video editors working on tight deadlines benefit from automated organization that eliminates manual YouTube searching and folder management.
TikTok creators finding relevant b-roll to pair with scripted voiceovers
Documentary editors sourcing archival or thematic footage by topic
YouTube editors organizing bulk b-roll collections for fast editing
Content creators automating tedious YouTube searches for visual themes
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sasoder/stockpile`
sections.usage:
```
I'm a video editor working on a documentary for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I have [NUMBER] of b-roll clips I need help organizing. Please analyze these clips and create a categorized list of relevant footage by topic. Include timestamps for each clip. Here are the clips: [CLIP LINKS].
```
